summary: Price and volume moved unusually compared with this stock's own history.
text: JPMorgan Chase shares moved following an upbeat revenue outlook provided by Co-President Doug Petno at a Barclays conference, where he flagged mid to high teens growth in third-quarter investment banking fees and markets revenue.
